description: PM-posture skill that picks the next 根回し Nemawashi seed for a project — the model chooses one seed from the candidate pool, and a script decides whether that choice may be made before the seed moves `unpicked/` → the seedbed root in one commit, which also appends the pick to the instance's Principal PM context when it has one. Halts outside a pm session or the pm subagent. Use when a project has no active seed and the next one has to be chosen — "pick the next seed", "what should we work next", "pick a nemawashi", "nemawashi-pick". Do not use for un-picking (nemawashi-unpick), cutting seeds (seeds-from-idea, seeds-from-product-docs), splitting the picked seed into stations (stations-from-seed), retiring or dropping a seed (nemawashi-retire, nemawashi-drop), or the instance seedbed under system/nemawashi/.
